title: Gold Bar Salts Pineapple Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml

It’s best suited to MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits, vape pens, and starter setups. Whether you're after a tropical flavour with a cool finish or looking for a bold fruit vape for any time of day, Pineapple Ice is a standout in the Gold Bar Nic Salt line-up.
